propertySets.name: Pset_CooledBeamPHistory
propertySets.definition: Common performance history attributes for a cooled beam.

properties.name: TotalCoolingCapacity
properties.definition: Total cooling capacity. This includes cooling capacity of beam and cooling capacity of supply air.

properties.name: TotalHeatingCapacity
properties.definition: Total heating capacity. This includes heating capacity of beam and heating capacity of supply air.

properties.name: BeamCoolingCapacity
properties.definition: Cooling capacity of beam. This excludes cooling capacity of supply air.

properties.name: BeamHeatingCapacity
properties.definition: Heating capacity of beam. This excludes heating capacity of supply air.

properties.name: CoolingWaterFlowRate
properties.definition: Water flow rate for cooling.

properties.name: HeatingWaterFlowRate
properties.definition: Water flow rate for heating.

properties.name: CorrectionFactorForCooling
properties.definition: Correction factor k as a function of water flow rate (used to calculate cooling capacity).

properties.name: CorrectionFactorForHeating
properties.definition: Correction factor k as a function of water flow rate (used to calculate heating capacity).

properties.name: WaterPressureDropCurves
properties.definition: Water pressure drop as function of water flow rate.

properties.name: SupplyWaterTemperatureCooling
properties.definition: Supply water temperature in cooling mode.

properties.name: ReturnWaterTemperatureCooling
properties.definition: Return water temperature in cooling mode.

properties.name: SupplyWaterTemperatureHeating
properties.definition: Supply water temperature in heating mode.

properties.name: ReturnWaterTemperatureHeating
properties.definition: Return water temperature in heating mode.

propertySets.name: Pset_CooledBeamTypeCommon
propertySets.definition:
Cooled beam common attributes.
SoundLevel and SoundAttenuation attributes deleted in IFC2x2 Pset Addendum: Use IfcSoundProperties instead.

properties.name: Reference
properties.definition: Reference ID for this specified type in this project (e.g. type 'A-1'), Also referred to as "construction type". It should be provided as an alternative to the name of the "object type", if the software does not support object types and no classification reference to a recognized classification system used.IFC4.3.0.0 DEPRECATION  The Reference property is deprecated and shall no longer be used, use attribute Name on the relating type instead.

properties.name: Status
properties.definition: Status of the element, predominately used in renovation or retrofitting projects. The status can be assigned to as "New" - element designed as new addition, "Existing" - element exists and remains, "Demolish" - element existed but is to be demolished,  "Temporary" - element will exists only temporary (like a temporary support structure).

properties.name: IsFreeHanging
properties.definition: Is it free hanging type (not mounted in a false ceiling)?

properties.name: PipeConnection
properties.definition: The manner in which the pipe connection is made to the cooled beam.

properties.name: WaterFlowControlSystemType
properties.definition: Factory fitted waterflow control system.

properties.name: WaterPressureRange
properties.definition: Allowable water circuit working pressure range.

properties.name: NominalCoolingCapacity
properties.definition: Nominal cooling capacity.

properties.name: NominalSurroundingTemperatureCooling
properties.definition: Nominal surrounding temperature (refers to nominal cooling capacity).

properties.name: NominalSurroundingHumidityCooling
properties.definition: Nominal surrounding humidity (refers to nominal cooling capacity).

properties.name: NominalSupplyWaterTemperatureCooling
properties.definition: Nominal supply water temperature (refers to nominal cooling capacity).

properties.name: NominalReturnWaterTemperatureCooling
properties.definition: Nominal return water temperature (refers to nominal cooling capacity).

properties.name: NominalWaterFlowCooling
properties.definition: Nominal water flow (refers to nominal cooling capacity).

properties.name: NominalHeatingCapacity
properties.definition: Nominal heating capacity.

properties.name: NominalSurroundingTemperatureHeating
properties.definition: Nominal surrounding temperature (refers to nominal heating capacity).

properties.name: NominalSupplyWaterTemperatureHeating
properties.definition: Nominal supply water temperature (refers to nominal heating capacity).

properties.name: NominalReturnWaterTemperatureHeating
properties.definition: Nominal return water temperature (refers to nominal heating capacity).

properties.name: NominalWaterFlowHeating
properties.definition: Nominal water flow (refers to nominal heating capacity).

properties.name: IntegratedLightingType
properties.definition: Integrated lighting in cooled beam.

properties.name: FinishColour
properties.definition: The finish colour of the object.

properties.name: CoilLength
properties.definition: Length of coil.

properties.name: CoilWidth
properties.definition: Width of coil.

propertySets.name: Qto_CooledBeamBaseQuantities
propertySets.definition: Base quantities that are common to the definition of all types of cooled beams.
